*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health
emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the
Governor’s E x e c u t i v e O r d e r N -29-2 0  ( https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-
content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf), please note that members of the public
will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council Meeting of August 25, 2020, at
2:00 P.M. as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
  electronically for consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers
  Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at
  yhorton@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk aphillips@cityofinglewood.org.
  To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration
  of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 A.M. the day of the meeting, and
  in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter.
  Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments
  received after 8:00 A.M. and prior to the close of the public hearings, will be made
  part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at
  310-412-5280 with any questions.

  2.  In Person: While adhering to and enforcing social distancing standards, members
  of the public can come to the Community Room located on the First Floor of
  Inglewood City Hall at 1 West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301, to listen,
  observe and make public comments.

  3.  By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments:
  Members of the public can participate in the meeting by telephone to listen and make
  comments by using the following:

  l Dial-In: 1-888-251-2949 or 1-215-861-0694 (Access Code: 5572468##):
  The conference begins at 1:30 p.m., Pacific Time, and all interested parties may join
  l
  the conference 5 minutes prior. Should any person need assistance with audio,
  please dial 1-888-796-6118. When dialing in, the operator will provide further
  instructions on how you can make public comments via phone.
  l If you are dialing in from a cell phone, please call from an area with good reception.
  Calls from landline phones are highly recommended.
  l If you are watching the meeting via Facebook Live or Channel 35 while also accessing
  the phone line, it is requested that you mute the sound of your video feed as it is
  delayed from the phone transmission. Additionally, when you are making public
  comments on the phone line, you will be inaudible due to feedback.

  4.  Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  l  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your
  cable provider for details.
   4.  Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  l  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your
  cable provider for details.
  l Live on-line through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video, at
  https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/.

The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to both observe and
listen to the meeting; however, members of the public who wish to orally address the
Legislative Body must use the public access options 2 and 3 noted above.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of
the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and
regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-
related modification or accommodation, or translation services in order to observe and/or
offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, aid, or
service by contacting the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310-412-5280, FAX at 310-
412-5533, One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301
or via email to yhorton@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the scheduled
meeting.

Inglewood, California
  August 25, 2020

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
August 25, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

MAYOR PROTEM APPOINTMENT. It was moved by Council Member Franklin,
and seconded by Council Member Dotson that the City Council does hereby appoint
Council Member Morales as Mayor Pro Tem. The motion was carried by the following
roll call vote:
Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin;
Noes: None; and
Absent: Mayor Butts.

Mayor Pro Tem Morales called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00
p.m.

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Pro Tem
Morales inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
Council on Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

There was no response.

Mayor Pro Tem Morales recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:01 p.m. for Closed
Session Item Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
hour of 2:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts/Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority
PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
item on the Agenda.
Wanda Brown, City Treasurer, spoke concerning Agenda Item No. DR-2, authorization
to pay invoices (Nos. 2000278207 and 2000312392) submitted by AECOM Technical
Services, Inc., for design support services on the Century Boulevard Mobility
Improvement Project (Project P212).

Dillion (last name unknown) spoke concerning Agenda Item No. 2, Rejection of Claims.

  agreement with the State of California for acceptance of the Fiscal Year 2021 Office of
  Traffic Safety grant funds in the total amount of $254,500, and 8, acceptance and
  approval of the recommendations of the Chief of Police pertaining to the expenditure of
  Fiscal Year 2020 Justice Assistance Grant Funds.

  Ms. Craft spoke concerning Agenda Item No. 7, approval of an agreement with the State

  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 132  CLAIMS DENIED. Letters from the Office of the City Attorney recommending the
  following:
  A. Reject Claim filed pursuant to Government Code Section 913:
  1) Jonte King for alleged vehicle damage (pothole) on May 10, 2020.
  B. Return Late Claim filed Pursuant to Government Code Section 912:
  1) Frances & Artis Rutledge for alleged vehicle damage, and personal injuries
  (pothole) on December 25, 2019.
  2) Mahal Patterson-Chin for alleged vehicle damage (storm drain) on February 2,
  2020.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, seconded by Council Member Dotson that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Reject claim listed as A1; and 2) Return late claims
  listed as B1 and B2. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 301  ADVANCED FUNDS AGREEMENT NOT APPROVED – THOMAS SAFRAN &
  ASSOCIATES; RESOLUTION NOT ADOPTED. This item was pulled from the
  Agenda.

 301  AGREEMENT NO. 20-237 APPROVED – CURTIS ROSENTHAL, INC. Staff
  report dated August 25, 2020, was presented recommending approval of an agreement
  with Curtis Rosenthal, Inc., for appraisal services related to Agreement No. 20-155
  (ENA).

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 20-237 in an amount not to
  exceed $1,000. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 171  AGREEMENT NO. 20-238 APPROVED - SIRSI CORPORATION, D.B.A.
  SIRSIDYNIX. Staff report dated August 25, 2020, was presented recommending
  approval of a five-year agreement with Sirsi Corporation, d.b.a. SirsiDynix, to purchase
  and implement an integrated library software system.

  2
 August 25, 2020

  was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 171  AGREEMENT NO. 20-239 APPROVED - BATEMAN COMMUNITY LIVING
  LLC DBA TRIO COMMUNITY MEALS; CITY COUNCIL’S APPROVAL
  RESCINDED – PAYMENT OF INVOICES FOR SERVICES. Staff report dated
  August 25, 2020, was presented recommending approval of an agreement with Bateman
  Community Living LLC dba TRIO Community Meals, to provide food services for the
  Elderly Nutrition Program (ENP).

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 20-239, in an amount not
  to exceed $150,000 for the time period of August 25, 2020 through September 30, 2020,
  inclusive; and 2) Rescind the City Council approval of June 23, 2020, to pay invoices for
  services covering the aforementioned time period. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 178  AGREEMENT NOS. 20-240 AND 21-140 APPROVED – STATE OF
  CALIFORNIA FISCAL YEAR 2021 OFFICE OF TRAFFIC SAFETY GRANT.
  Staff report dated August 25, 2020, was presented recommending approval of agreements
  with the State of California for acceptance of the Fiscal Year 2021 Office of Traffic
  Safety grant funds in the total amount of $254,500.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 20-240 with the State of
  California for the acceptance of the Selective Traffic Enforcement Program grant in the
  amount of $242,000; 2) Approve Agreement No. 21-140 with the State of California for
  the acceptance of the Traffic Records Improvement Project grant in the amount of $12,
  500; and 3) Direct that the said funds be budgeted for use during Fiscal Year 2020-2021.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 173  CHIEF OF POLICE RECOMMENDATIONS ACCEPTED AND APPROVED -
  EXPENDITURE OF FISCAL YEAR 2020 JAG FUNDS – AUTHORIZED. Staff
  report dated August 25, 2020, was presented recommending acceptance and approval of
  the recommendations of the Chief of Police pertaining to the expenditure of Fiscal Year
  2020 Justice Assistance Grant Funds.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Receive and file the report pertaining to the United
  States Department of Justice (USDOJ) Fiscal Year 2020 Byrne Memorial Justice
  Assistance Grant (JAG); 2) Accept and approve the recommendation of the Chief of
  Police; 3) Approve Certifications and Assurances required for acceptance of Fiscal Year
  2020 JAG funds; and 4) Authorize the expenditure of Fiscal Year 2020 JAG funds in the
  amount of $49,319 for the approved recommendation, and direct that said funds be
  included in the 2020-2021 Fiscal Year budget. The motion was carried by the following
  roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 183  CONTRACT AWARDED AND AGREEMENT NO. 20-241 APPROVED -
  STEPHEN DORECK EQUIPMENT RENTALS, INC. Staff report dated August 25,
  2020, was presented recommending award of contract and approval of an agreement with
